ev: Heavy runoff from several inches of heavy rain was observed flowing across Roanoke Road in the Town of Christiansburg, making the road impassible until the flooding receded. No damage was reported.

Runoff from heavy rain falling at rates of 4 to 5 inches per hour caused multiple creeks and drainages in the community of Alleghany Springs to flood out of their banks several inches deep across nearby roads. No damage was reported.
Heavy runoff from several inches of heavy rain caused damage to a portion of Sycamore Street in the town of Rocky Mount.

Story Creek was observed flowing anywhere from 12 to 18 inches deep over the intersection of Franklin Street and Old Ferrum Road. This is a known flood-prone location given the sharp bend in the creek and the narrow culvert under the road. No damage was reported to the road however.
South Fork Blackwater River was observed out of its banks and flowing several inches deep across Callaway Road, making the road impassible until the flooding receded. No damage was reported.
Turners Creek was observed out of its banks and flowing several inches deep across Turners Creek Road, making the road impassible until the flooding receded. No damage was reported.

The 6600 block of Callaway Road near the town of Rocky Mount was observed flooded and impassable due to runoff from several inches of rain flowing across the road into the Blackwater River. No damage was reported.

Runoff from several inches of heavy rain caused Tharp Creek to flow several inches deep across the intersection of Dry Hill Road and Tharp Creek Road in the town of Ferrum, making the road impassible until the flooding receded. No damage was reported.

Doe Run creek was observed flowing out of its banks several inches deep across both Doe Run Road and Ashpone Tavern Road. These roads were impassible until the flooding receded. MRMS Crest Unit Streamflow indicated flows of nearly 840 cfs per square mile at this location at 12:00 am EDT on the 17th, while the 3-hour ARI was maxed out at a 200-year event.
Six Mile Post Road was observed flooded and impassible as Hatchet Creek was observed flooding several inches out of its banks over the roadway. No damage was reported to the road.
lsr: Report from mPING: River/Creek overflowing; Cropland/Yard/Basement Flooding.

The 6600 block of Callaway road in Rocky Mount is flooded, and not passable.
